memories.content: The atlas release build repeatedly gets cancelled by CI (2026-08-11, 2026-08-19, 2026-09-01) because the pipeline kills any job over 30 minutes, and every release build starts with an empty cargo registry cache that adds ~18 minutes — the fix is to cache the cargo registry between CI runs (or raise the timeout) so builds start warm.
